## Validation checklist

- [ ] `npm run test` green
- [ ] `npm run typecheck` green
- [ ] `npm run lint` green
- [ ] `npm run build` green (required when touching build or styles)
- [ ] No secrets, tokens or private notes added (check `git status` + diff)
- [ ] Visible UI text goes through `t()` in `src/i18n/pt-BR.ts`
- [ ] New behavior covered by co-located tests where it makes sense
